events.description: 一条废弃机铠管线经由幽灵斯科特改造，竟变成了可为幽灵赋予肉身的「林登™具身机铠」生产线！可这位老友难得做回善事，居然被横空出世的拉克什米绊住了脚，你决定与伙伴们携手，帮他完成考核，从「绯闻女友」手下顺利脱身！
events.description_en: A decommissioned mechatron pipeline, retrofitted by ghost Skott, has somehow become a production line for "Lyndon™ EmbodiMech," capable of giving ghosts physical form! But the one time this old friend decides to do something good, he gets tangled up with the out-of-nowhere arrival of Rakshmi. You and your companions decide to lend a hand, help him pass the assessment, and get him out from under his "rumored girlfriend's" thumb!

events.name_en: Honkai: Star Rail · The Fluffy Movie: Overheated
events.description: 让《苍天航路绒绒号》烂尾？抱歉，最富责任心的伟大漫画家「模糊二维马」非但做不到，还要画出个美食剧场版！她给你留下了一笔亟待继承的遗产，想要得到它，就得先完成这篇旷世奇作，不过，「画」漫画可没有你想象中那么简单……
events.description_en: Leave Fluffy Across the Blue unfinished? Sorry, but the greatest and most responsible comic artist, Blurry_QR_Colt, could never do such a thing. In fact, she's even going to draw a gourmet story version! She has left behind an inheritance waiting to be claimed. To get your hands on it, you'll have to first finish this masterpiece. However, "drawing" comics isn't as simple as you think...
